name: Beekeper's Workshop
description: A beekeeper's timber work shed filled with wax, moulds, wicks, honey vessels, shelves, and the tools of candle making. By day it belongs to a widower and his new apprentice; by night, its finest work is done by someone much smaller.
atmosphere: Warm beeswax and old wood under a silence where every dropped tool sounds enormous. Newly scattered iron horseshoes turn the familiar workshop into a poisoned maze.
notes: Buaic works here at night in exchange for honey. The widowed beekeeper understands the arrangement, but a new apprentice has scattered and hidden iron horseshoes to ward off evil Fairies. Do not impose a fixed horseshoe count; the Iron and Wax Mission uses one unique clearance tracker. The filename's existing ‘Beekeper’ spelling is preserved to avoid an unsafe out-of-band rename during content editing.
